sources.title: Natural Earth 1:10m Admin-1 States and Provinces
sources.locator: regions[].id; source and audit metadata
sources.reliability_notes: Identity and geometry inventory only. The repository explicitly marks these modern admin-1 geometries as approximate fallbacks where dedicated 1900 subdivisions are unavailable; this source is not evidence of 1900 boundaries or production.
sources.observation_period_notes: No bounded observation period is extracted from this locator; publication date is not an observation date.

sources.title: WWO existing 1900 commodity market catalog
sources.locator: commodities[].commodity_id
sources.reliability_notes: Canonical ID compatibility reference only. Existing prices, recipes, and capacities remain runtime calibration data and are not promoted as historical evidence by this pack.
sources.observation_period_notes: No bounded observation period is extracted from this locator; publication date is not an observation date.

sources.title: Westphalia
sources.locator: Geography; Mineral wealth; Manufacturing industry; railway and river navigation paragraphs
sources.reliability_notes: Near-period reference synthesis. Strong for identifying the Westphalian/Ruhr coal, iron, manufacturing, agriculture, labor, and transport structure; not used here as a substitute for mine-by-mine or plant-by-plant statistics.
sources.observation_period_notes: No bounded observation period is extracted from this locator; publication date is not an observation date.

sources.title: Lancashire
sources.locator: Geology; coal supply; agriculture; Industries and Trade
sources.reliability_notes: Near-period regional synthesis. Used for qualitative relationships among Lancashire coal, iron, cotton, machinery, labor concentration, Liverpool, canals, and railways.
sources.observation_period_notes: No bounded observation period is extracted from this locator; publication date is not an observation date.

sources.title: Cotton Manufacture
sources.locator: England and Lancashire discussion; coal, humidity, Liverpool, and export geography
sources.reliability_notes: Near-period industry synthesis. Used only to support the sector-to-place relationship; no production number is copied into the pilot.
sources.observation_period_notes: No bounded observation period is extracted from this locator; publication date is not an observation date.

sources.title: Wales
sources.locator: Population and Industries sections; South Wales coalfield, ironstone, ironworks, and coal quality
sources.reliability_notes: Near-period regional synthesis. Supports qualitative South Wales mineral, industrial, population, and export-port evidence.
sources.observation_period_notes: No bounded observation period is extracted from this locator; publication date is not an observation date.

sources.title: Glamorganshire
sources.locator: Mining and Manufactures section; coal, iron, steel, tinplate, copper, Cardiff, Port Talbot, Swansea
sources.reliability_notes: Near-period county-level synthesis. Used to keep South Wales claims tied to named coalfield and industrial districts rather than to a country macro-index.
sources.observation_period_notes: No bounded observation period is extracted from this locator; publication date is not an observation date.

sources.title: Merthyr Tydfil
sources.locator: Industrial prosperity, ironworks, collieries, Cardiff works, and railways paragraphs
sources.reliability_notes: Near-period town-level synthesis. Supports an industrial-labor and rail-connected node inside the South Wales pilot; not a full coalfield boundary.
sources.observation_period_notes: No bounded observation period is extracted from this locator; publication date is not an observation date.

sources.title: Russia
sources.locator: Geology section; Donets Coal-Measures and iron-mines
sources.reliability_notes: Near-period national synthesis. Used to identify the Donets geological and mineral-production system; present spatial IDs are treated as modern physical proxies, not historical political units.
sources.observation_period_notes: No bounded observation period is extracted from this locator; publication date is not an observation date.

sources.title: Ekaterinoslav (government)
sources.locator: Mineral resources and Donets coalfield paragraphs
sources.reliability_notes: Near-period administrative-geography synthesis. Supports coal, iron ore, and associated mineral extraction in the western part of the Donets system.
sources.observation_period_notes: No bounded observation period is extracted from this locator; publication date is not an observation date.

sources.title: Europe
sources.locator: Railways paragraph; Donets basin connections to Sea of Azov ports
sources.reliability_notes: Near-period transport synthesis. Used for corridor-level rail and port linkage only; no route capacity is inferred.
sources.observation_period_notes: No bounded observation period is extracted from this locator; publication date is not an observation date.

sources.title: Don Cossacks, Territory of the
sources.locator: Agriculture, coal-mining, manufacturing, and exports paragraphs
sources.reliability_notes: Near-period regional synthesis. Used only for the agricultural and extractive context adjacent to the Donets system; it does not define the pilot's spatial extent.
sources.observation_period_notes: No bounded observation period is extracted from this locator; publication date is not an observation date.

sources.title: Twelfth Census of the United States: Mines and Quarries: 1902
sources.locator: Pennsylvania bituminous coal and mine-production sections
sources.reliability_notes: Official federal statistical source. The report is a future quantitative extraction candidate; this pilot deliberately records no numerical value from it.
sources.observation_period_notes: The official locator identifies statistics for mines and quarries for 1902; this is not a direct 1900 observation.

sources.title: Census Reports, Volume 10: Manufactures, Part 4: Special Reports on Selected Industries
sources.version_or_edition: Twelfth Census; iron and steel sections
sources.locator: Iron and Steel section; Pennsylvania mineral-fuel and ore-supply discussion
sources.reliability_notes: Official federal statistical source. It distinguishes Pennsylvania fuel geography from imported Lake Superior ore; that distinction is preserved qualitatively in the pilot.
sources.observation_period_notes: Twelfth Census was taken in 1900; this report was published in 1902.

sources.title: Pennsylvania
sources.locator: Minerals and Manufactures sections; coal, coke, pig iron, steel, railways, and agriculture
sources.reliability_notes: Near-period state-level synthesis. Used for the qualitative integrated coal-coke-iron-steel system and transport/labor context; no source quantity is copied.
sources.observation_period_notes: No bounded observation period is extracted from this locator; publication date is not an observation date.

sources.title: Pittsburg (Pennsylvania)
sources.locator: Industrial products, railways, rivers, and population paragraphs
sources.reliability_notes: Near-period city-level synthesis. Used to support the dense labor, river, and rail-linked steel node nested in the Pennsylvania spatial region.
sources.observation_period_notes: No bounded observation period is extracted from this locator; publication date is not an observation date.

sources.title: Bengal
sources.locator: Mineral Products; Commerce; Railways sections
sources.reliability_notes: Near-period regional synthesis. Supports Bengal coal, jute, rice, Calcutta port, rail, river-steamer, and labor-system relationships. The pilot keeps Bengal's historical extent separate from modern spatial IDs.
sources.observation_period_notes: No bounded observation period is extracted from this locator; publication date is not an observation date.

sources.title: India
sources.locator: Manufactures; jute cultivation and jute-mill discussion
sources.reliability_notes: Near-period national synthesis. Used for the jute-growing geography and Calcutta-centered mill relationship; no acreage, output, or workforce figure is staged.
sources.observation_period_notes: No bounded observation period is extracted from this locator; publication date is not an observation date.

sources.title: Kiang-Su
sources.locator: Physical geography; commerce; waterways; Shanghai, Nanking, Su-chow, and railway paragraphs
sources.reliability_notes: Near-period provincial synthesis. Supports the Jiangsu/Shanghai waterway, port, agriculture, silk, cotton, and rail context; it is not a modern boundary claim.
sources.observation_period_notes: No bounded observation period is extracted from this locator; publication date is not an observation date.

sources.title: Shanghai
sources.locator: Trade, manufacturing, cotton, silk, rice/paper mills, and shipbuilding paragraphs
sources.reliability_notes: Near-period port and industrial synthesis. Supports port-centered manufacturing and river-trade evidence; the pilot does not copy the source's trade values or tonnages.
sources.observation_period_notes: No bounded observation period is extracted from this locator; publication date is not an observation date.

sources.title: Yangtsze-Kiang
sources.locator: River course and commercial-waterway description
sources.reliability_notes: Near-period geographic synthesis. Used to support the river-connectivity evidence only; no navigability capacity is inferred.
sources.observation_period_notes: No bounded observation period is extracted from this locator; publication date is not an observation date.
